cohort: Six patients who had clinical features suggestive of corneal trauma induced by forceps delivery were retrospectively reviewed.
finding: Vertical to oblique corneal Descemet's membrane (DM) tears were noted in all 6 patients, with one patient having bilateral involvement and ages of presentation ranging from 5 to 39 years.
mod_finding: Forceps assisted vaginal delivery was the identified cause of corneal Descemet's membrane tears in all patients, emphasizing the need for careful decision-making and mandatory ophthalmologist referral for neonates born this way.
